motifs.name: riff
motifs.note: two bars in 3+3+2. The first climbs to the seventh and is left hanging on the fourth; the second starts the same way and comes down to the tonic and stays on it. The first version of this was one bar that stopped mid-figure and repeated -- a question asked sixteen times

motifs.name: riff_up
motifs.note: the same riff a third higher, for the second half of C

motifs.name: wail
motifs.note: the only slow thing in the piece: the tonic, the flat second over it, and a fall through the flat sixth

motifs.name: wail_cut
motifs.note: its first two notes at double speed, for the melt

motifs.name: pound
motifs.note: the bass: the root on every off-beat, in the gaps the kick leaves -- so the low end alternates kick, sub, kick, sub instead of being one continuous rumble

motifs.name: lurch
motifs.note: the same root, half-time and limping, for the void

ops.note: the wail is cut off by the roll before it can resolve
